metadata.title: Fast-Food Brand Perceptual Map
metadata.note: PCA and factor analysis are fit on the brand-attribute percentage columns only. Brand Asset and market share are held out for interpretation.

clusters.label: Mainstream trust-and-value staples
clusters.description: Large, familiar chains with high trust, reliability, good-value scores, Brand Asset, and market share.

clusters.label: Premium and contemporary leaders
clusters.description: Brands that combine strong assets with prestige, trendiness, upper-class associations, or contemporary style.

clusters.label: Value and traditional chains
clusters.description: More traditional or straightforward brands with lower contemporary-premium scores.

clusters.label: Crowded challengers
clusters.description: A broad middle of chains with weaker brand-strength scores and less separation on the two main factors.
